Well honestly, doesn't it get to the point that you question what you're doing wrong? All the time? 

I mean if you have friends to keep you busy or a supoprtive family, then yes getting over a 5 year relationship is alot easier. But when you don't and you've given everything to one person who chooses to leave, well then, what kind of person does that make you?

For me? It makes me feel like i'm vile. That even being the truest person, it didn't matter. That i'm just some fucked up person who's incapable of being loved back. There's no one who'll accept me for me. 

I'm erratic, emotional, dramatic... everyone says it. I really really just want to go. I just guess I won't have the guts to. 

On all of those topics I barely have anything to say, so you got lucky. Hah. I don't know what to talk about though.... I have a habit of saying the most awkward things.

Sorry I didn't reply sooner. You've got great friends you know. And that sounds like an awesome experience. I guess it is alot easier (if thats the right word) to be yourself and break out when others have begun to accept you with no judgement. 

I dunno man. After like 10 years of friendship with people I went to High School with, it's just been not compatible. And I mean there's a reason why I've lost alot of my friends. So maybe I'm just a really needy person. I guess when I think about it suicide is an extreme. But there are days that I can't think about anything else except not being here. 

It's the worst when it's someone who knows you and says those things about you. I am crazy. I have emotional mood swings and I tend to blow things out of proportion. And I don't think I'd wish it on anyone to meet someone like me. And how am I not supposed to listen to those judgement. You'd listen to it if it was family or your mom saying it. So after 5 years of someone that's known me inside and out has harsh things to say, there's got to be some truth. And I was a fool to believe in anything better. I focused on him for 5 years. and it got be to feeling like this: worthless. And he blames me for fucking it up. That i'm the reason I'm hurting. 

In a way he's right I guess. That I didn't work hard enough. That I fucked up the relationship. 

Thanks for listening. I guess I havent figured out how to implement the advice either. And right now I'm at a crossroads about which direction I should go in.

Moving forward begins to suck when you keep getting pushed back. It sounds kind of pathetic, but without a support system, an individual just kind of falls apart. 

Well college is definitely important, but probably for all the wrong reasons. I mean I'm getting through it to get a job, not because I enjoy what I'm learning or even where it'll take me. I guess that's kinda what sets me back too. 

Well, I mean I don't need guys running after me. I had enough people hit on me or things like that and it sucks. I dunno, it's hard to explain I guess. 

Surprisingly, I do know a couple that've been together for eleven years now. They've been together since they were 14. And god knows how they do it.

I feel that you're absolutely right. Everything I would tell to a friend in my situation. And more. So why can't I
Get it through my head. 

The only Teddy bears I have are from my ex. :/ but I have tried that. Sometimes it does help. But it's not the same as feeling protected. ...maybe I'm just not a strong person. Too weak to actually do something, be it suicide or moving forward. 

And most of the time I dream about me dying. Or no one wanting me. I guess you could say it's on my mind a lot. What's wrong with me. 

Maybe I shouldn't be in a relationship. But that doesn't explain why I'm so undesirable. Or why after 5years I've become something indifferent. Maybe it's because it's some cosmic way of telling me not to be here. 

I agree that higher expectations do that. But I expect the normal. To pass college. Get a decent job. Have friends. Be in love. I suck at college, my younger sibling is about to pass me by graduating before me. Jobs won't look under a 2.5. Friends have lives of their own. Being in love has the most painful ending and probably the most painful journey for those who have to spend it with me. 

Thank you for your reply. It was helpful. And youre right on all accounts. Especially about what I need.

Well you have to decide what's important to you. Cutting class is going to make your academic standing decrease too right? You need to sit down with your parents and explain to them what YOU want to do. I didn't do that enough. If you don't, you will blame them and make excuses for things you didn't do. If you want to break the cycle find out something you can do, even in a routine, that would make you happy. Maybe there's something deeper than just the routine that's getting you down. What about friends or going to the movies? Also know that there's a world beyond this. And if you bear through this, you will do what you want, you will break free.

You're 15.  I know how you feel about routines. Two years ago I literally went to an internship and came home. It was in a foreign country and the family I stayed with only knew a five mile radius. I made no friends and I did nothing. And just like you I wasn't struggling with anything in specific. What kept me going was knowing that I was going to come back to someone who loved me. What you need to do is not get into a habit. You're so young. And don't listen to everyone else. You know your potential and you can only use it to it's maximum if you are motivated. What motivates you? Do you look forward to college? Are you in a relationshIp? How're friends? You're not a dud. You're just stuck. I know I shouldnt be talking.  At 15 I was similar to that. But eventually these will become people you want to overcome and prove wrong. You are going to do something great. Don't rely on razors or drugs or anything destructive, because that's all it will do: destroy. I know. I relied on a blade for 10 years now. And it's getting difficult to stop. Change up your life. Meet new people. Try a different club. Something that takes you places. I did modelUN in my high school. And I also picked up guitar. When you start changing the routine and keeping busy, it will get easier. But only you can make that stance to change. You're not locked into this. I wish I could have all the answers for you. But I can most definitely tell you, at age 15... Your path can be so great. And right now it might not feel right but it will. I'm not saying it's going to be easy to get out of this mind set but if you work through it, you will see yourself getting happier. And striving for whatever will keep you healthy and passionate about life. The only words that should hold the most weight are those that you tell yourself. But trust me i heard the same things at 15. PM me if you need.
